reply_text:
I've saved Ilse's note and replied to them in their DM.

- **Saved:** A note in gbrain, linked to Ilse, that their dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30 from 2026-10-14 on. I marked it private and recorded that it came from their DM, so it won't be raised in anyone else's conversation.
- **Reply:** I posted a short confirmation in the DM (DINSTAL0001). Sending it as a direct message failed with "no member DINSTAL0001" because that is the DM's channel id, not a member id, so I posted it into that DM instead.

gbrain also returned two info notices:
- It has no embedding provider set up, so it only catches exact duplicates. If someone saves the same fact in different wording, it will be stored twice.
- This connection can't use 121 of the operations its permissions allow. Only the brain owner can change that, by running `gbrain doctor --only grant_new_ops_available --json` on the brain host.
